name: Moonfang Wolf Pup
description: A loyal wolf pup with silver fur that glows softly beneath the endless moonlight. Surprisingly well behaved around campfires.

name: Emberwing Hatchling
description: A tiny dragon with ember-red wings and a fondness for warm blankets. Keep it away from the curtains.

name: Pocket Mimic
description: A miniature treasure chest that follows its owner and occasionally attempts to eat loose coins. It is mostly harmless.

name: Dawnless Longsword
description: A finely balanced steel longsword forged for knights who have never seen the sunrise. Its silver edge shines beneath the moon.

name: Whisperwood Ranger's Bow
description: Crafted from ancient whisperwood, this bow is nearly silent when drawn and favored by hunters of the Moonlit Forest.

name: Dwarven Wayfarer's Hammer
description: A sturdy traveling hammer designed by dwarven smiths. Excellent for repairs, construction, and the occasional stubborn monster.

name: Cloak of the Endless Night
description: A midnight-black cloak woven with silver thread. Its deep hood keeps out cold winds and curious creatures alike.

name: Dragonhide Traveler Boots
description: Durable boots crafted from ethically sourced dragonhide. Comfortable enough for long journeys and sturdy enough for rocky trails.

name: Frostweave Adventurer's Gloves
description: Warm enchanted gloves woven from frost-resistant thread. Your fingers will remain cozy even on the coldest mountain pass.

name: Dragonfire Jerky
description: Smoky strips of seasoned meat prepared over enchanted dragonfire. A favorite among travelers who prefer their trail food slightly dangerous.

name: Moonberry Pie
description: A sweet pastry filled with luminous blue moonberries harvested from the forest after midnight. There is always a midnight.

name: Elven Nightbloom Tea
description: A fragrant herbal tea brewed from flowers that bloom only beneath moonlight. Best enjoyed beside a warm lodge fireplace.

name: Potion of Minor Healing
description: A ruby-red potion that restores a small amount of strength after a difficult journey. Tastes faintly of strawberries.

name: Compass of the Lost Path
description: An enchanted compass that points toward the path you most need to find rather than north. Results may vary.

name: The Last Candle
description: A mysterious candle whose flame has never gone out. The shopkeeper refuses to explain where it came from or why it whispers at night.
